item.title: Mortgagee sales surge 82.5% in 2025 — will they continue to dominate auctions this year?
item.description: Mortgagee sales — also known as bank sales — dominated Singapore’s auction market in 2025, surging 82.5% y-o-y to 312 listings, up from 171 the year before. This marked the highest level since 2019, when 630 mortgagee sales were listed, according to an auction report released by Knight Frank Singapore on Feb 2. item.title: Receiver’s sale of four-bedder at Marina Bay Suites for $4.4 mil
item.description: A four-bedroom apartment at Marina Bay Suites will be on the block at Knight Frank’s upcoming auction on Feb 26. Located on the 51st floor, the unit spans 2,067 sq ft and has a guide price of $4.4 million, which translates to $2,129 psf. item.title: Knight Frank Singapore resets for growth, with focus on capital, occupiers and management
item.description: Knight Frank Singapore is entering a new phase following AF Global’s sale of its 55% stake to Knight Frank Asia Pacific. With that, Knight Frank Singapore is now fully owned by the regional arm, which is, in turn, a subsidiary of the London-based global real estate consultancy. item.title: Three-bedder at Costa Rhu sold for $2.03 mil profit
item.description: Topping the list of most profitable condo resale deals during the period of Jan 18 to 27 is the sale of a three-bedroom unit at Costa Rhu, a 99-year leasehold condo in District 15. The 1,647 sq ft unit on the seventh floor was transacted for $2.8 million ($1,700 psf) on Jan 20. It was purchased for more than $765,800 ($465 psf) in June 2005. item.title: The Holland Collection achieves price peak of $2,434 psf
item.description: A resale unit at The Holland Collection topped the list for new condo psf-price highs achieved over the period of Jan 18 to Jan 27. The 1,841 sq ft, three-bedroom apartment on the second floor changed hands for $4.48 million, or $2,434 psf, on Jan 23. This is the first time a unit at The Holland Collection has transacted above $2,400 psf. The new psf-price level is nearly 10% higher than the previous record, set in 2010.
